messages:
Maria O'Neill: Heads-up — after yesterday's KMS key policy change, several Dedicated GPU nodes in eu-west-1 cannot pull bootstrap artifacts. s3:GetObject AccessDenied from instance-profile role.

infra-bot: [alert] 2025-11-04T09:34:12Z - node-provisioner-eu-west-1 - object fetch failed - GET https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-artifacts/bootstrap.tgz - 403

Sam W: Hmm. Did the key policy restrict decrypt to a specific role/account? I saw a tighten on kms:Decrypt condition.

Li Chen: Reproduced. Provisioning logs show KMS Decrypt denied for role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/redwood-dedicated-node

Li Chen: Error snippet:
```
2025-11-04T09:33:58Z ERROR: KMSException: AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to use KMS key: alias/aws/redwood-bootstrap
    at com.aws.kms... kms:Decrypt denied
```

Oliver K: If nodes can't decrypt bootstrap metadata they fallback to AMI-level init which doesn't have cached model weights -> provisioning fails or falls back to shared on-demand instances.

Maria O'Neill: That fallback was the issue in staging — CPU instances spiked and cost alarm fired :grimacing:

Sam W: Can we rollback the key policy to the previous one temporarily? Or add explicit statement to allow the node role kms:Decrypt for the key.

Li Chen: Proposed minimal fix (add to KMS key policy):
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowNodeRoleDecrypt",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/redwood-dedicated-node" },
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

Maria O'Neill: Also need to check cross-account access for build systems (artifacts pipeline runs from 555666777888)

Oliver K: We should also add an S3 bucket policy guard: only allow GetObject if kms:EncryptionContext: \"artifact\":\"bootstrap\" — helps limit scope.

sec-bot: [security note] Remember to log KMS:Decrypt events to CloudWatch and forward to audit log for the week after change.

Sam W: Plan: 1) apply temporary key-policy allow for node role (canary to 2 nodes) 2) verify bootstrap pull & provisioning 3) roll forward full policy including tighter conditions + S3 encryption-context check 4) schedule postmortem.

Maria O'Neill: I'm on the canary now. Ping when bootstrap succeeds.

infra-bot: canary node id i-0abc1234 started, hit GET success 200 for bootstrap.tgz at 09:41:12Z

Li Chen: Confirmed provisioning finished on canary GPU node. Rolling to remaining capacity in eu-west-1.

Oliver K: Open question: alerting threshold for cost spikes — current alarm triggers after 24h. Can we add short-term burn rate alert for migrations like this?

Maria O'Neill: Filing follow-up ticket. @Sam W @Oliver K please add remediation playbook steps for next time.

Sam W: Will do, adding runbook + one-liner to revert key policy quickly. :thumbsup:
